text: Binary per-row judgment: 1 if at least one comment in OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP, parsed) presents a well-reasoned counterargument, i.e. directly challenges the OP's stated view with coherent, relevant, logically structured reasoning or evidence; 0 if the list is valid and no comment does so (including an empty list). OP title and argument are used only to identify the view being countered; comment order is ignored. Output null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if both OP title and argument are missing. Excludes any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred (even if embedded in the argument); generic delta/platform-rule discussion is allowed where relevant. The conversation column is not used.
